_comment: Public-tier snapshot fixtures. Every case is the complete buildPublicReading output for its date, recorded so that any change to core/public.js OR to a string in the content tables fails loudly instead of drifting. Regenerate deliberately, in the same change that justifies the drift, and record the diff in journal.md (DOCTRINE §4). Regenerated 2026-07-29 three times, once per controller ruling: the nine-mode collapse, the lifePath rename, and the move of the mode driver off the free surface to the birthday number (§1.D v0.59). Regenerated again 2026-07-29 (P1-D): the HKO deep-audit fix moved 1911 lixia from 05-06 to 05-07 (this fixture's 1911-05-06 case is now the day BEFORE the boundary, not on it) and added the 1912-01-07 and 1927-09-08 boundary-day cases. Regenerated 2026-07-31 (calc v4, §1.B v0.62): every case gains mode.modeKey / mode.bridged / mode.bridgeNote, sources.mode names the master bridge, and the two master-birthday cases below were added.
_pii_rule: Fixture dates MUST be synthetic — calendar/calibration anchors chosen for the calc path they exercise, never a real person’s date of birth. See DOCTRINE.md §11.
_coverage: The 21 cases cover all five day-master elements, both strengths, all five seasonal states, all nine authored mode keys, and both reachable MASTER birthday values (11 and 22) - the mode driver under calc v4. They also carry every date calc v3.1 moved: lunar new year 1916 and the 1911, 1912, and 1927 solar terms - including the exact 1912 xiaohan and 1927 bailu boundary days, added 2026-07-29 (P1-D) after an HKO audit found the 1912 term was never actually in this set and 1927-09-09 alone could not discriminate the corrected bailu cutoff from the pre-PR-#140 one.
